title: Reading the Trial, and When the Cell Is Gone

scenes.visual: Title card: Reading the Trial, and When the Cell Is Gone.

scenes.tts: Nine of twelve children met a trial's endpoint. Does that mean most of their hearing came back?
scenes.visual: A bar of twelve child icons, nine shaded, with a question mark above.
scenes.narration: Nine of twelve children met a trial's endpoint. Does that mean most of their hearing came back?

scenes.tts: The D B O T O trial treated twelve children with otoferlin-related profound deafness.
scenes.caption: The DB-OTO trial treated twelve children with OTOF-related profound deafness.
scenes.visual: Twelve child icons with a trial card. On screen: DB-OTO, New England Journal of Medicine; open-label, single group.
scenes.narration: The DB-OTO trial treated twelve children with OTOF-related profound deafness.

scenes.tts: Nine met the week twenty-four endpoint: an average of seventy decibels hearing level or better.
scenes.caption: Nine met the week 24 endpoint: an average of 70 dB HL or better.
scenes.visual: Nine icons shaded against a threshold line. On screen: 9 of 12 met 70 dB HL or better at week 24.
scenes.narration: Nine met the week 24 endpoint: an average of 70 dB HL or better.

scenes.tts: Three of twelve reached average normal sensitivity.
scenes.visual: Three of the icons marked with a separate label. On screen: 3 of 12 average normal.
scenes.narration: Three of twelve reached average normal sensitivity.

scenes.tts: So nine of twelve is a share of children meeting an endpoint. It is not a share of hearing.
scenes.visual: Two labels side by side: share of children, and share of hearing, with the second crossed out.
scenes.narration: So nine of twelve is a share of children meeting an endpoint. It is not a share of hearing.

scenes.tts: In a separate report by Wang and colleagues, one child's baseline was above the test ceiling of ninety-five decibels.
scenes.caption: In a separate report by Wang and colleagues, one child's baseline was above the test ceiling of 95 dB.
scenes.visual: A threshold scale with an arrow running off the top of the scale. On screen: Wang and colleagues, 2024; baseline above 95 dB.
scenes.narration: In a separate report by Wang and colleagues, one child's baseline was above the test ceiling of 95 dB.

scenes.tts: At week twenty-six the threshold was fifty-eight decibels. What does that tell you about the improvement?
scenes.caption: At week 26 the threshold was 58 dB. What does that tell you about the improvement?
scenes.visual: The scale with the week 26 value marked and the baseline still off scale. On screen: 58 dB at week 26.
scenes.narration: At week 26 the threshold was 58 dB. What does that tell you about the improvement?

scenes.visual: Hold on the censored scale.

scenes.tts: Only that it was more than thirty-seven decibels. The true baseline was never measured.
scenes.caption: Only that it was more than 37 dB. The true baseline was never measured.
scenes.visual: The gap drawn as a bracket with a greater-than sign. On screen: improvement greater than 37 dB.
scenes.narration: Only that it was more than 37 dB. The true baseline was never measured.

scenes.tts: A floor on the improvement is not the improvement, and it is not a percentage of hearing.
scenes.visual: A floor line under an open-ended arrow, with a crossed-out percentage sign.
scenes.narration: A floor on the improvement is not the improvement, and it is not a percentage of hearing.

scenes.tts: Now the harder case. When the hair cell itself is gone, putting back its gene cannot help.
scenes.visual: A gap in the sensory epithelium where a hair cell was, with surviving supporting cells drawn on either side.
scenes.narration: Now the harder case. When the hair cell itself is gone, putting back its gene cannot help.

scenes.tts: A new hair cell has to be made, perhaps from a surviving supporting cell.
scenes.visual: One supporting cell beside the gap highlighted, with an arrow toward the empty place.
scenes.narration: A new hair cell has to be made, perhaps from a surviving supporting cell.

scenes.tts: Birds replace damaged hair cells. In adult quail, counts recovered to within five percent of the original.
scenes.visual: A bird cochlea refilling with new hair cells. On screen: Ryals and Rubel, 1988; within 5 percent.
scenes.narration: Birds replace damaged hair cells. In adult quail, counts recovered to within five percent of the original.

scenes.tts: The adult mammalian cochlea does not do this. One mammalian exception is vestibular, in the guinea-pig utricle.
scenes.visual: A mouse cochlea with no new cells, beside a utricle where hair cells reappear. On screen: Forge and colleagues, 1993.
scenes.narration: The adult mammalian cochlea does not do this. One mammalian exception is vestibular, in the guinea-pig utricle.

scenes.tts: In newborn mice, the factor Atoh one pushes nonsensory cells of the cochlea, chiefly in the greater epithelial ridge, toward hair cells.
scenes.caption: In newborn mice, the factor ATOH1 pushes nonsensory cells of the cochlea, chiefly in the greater epithelial ridge, toward hair cells.
scenes.visual: A cochlear cross-section with the greater epithelial ridge highlighted and labelled; a cell there receives one labelled factor and grows a small bundle. On screen: ATOH1, postnatal day 1, greater epithelial ridge.
scenes.narration: In newborn mice, the factor ATOH1 pushes nonsensory cells of the cochlea, chiefly in the greater epithelial ridge, toward hair cells.

scenes.tts: Would the same factor work just as well a week later?
scenes.visual: The day 1 panel beside a blank day 8 panel with a question mark.
scenes.narration: Would the same factor work just as well a week later?

scenes.visual: Hold on the blank day 8 panel.

scenes.tts: By day eight, the factor alone gave very few new hair cells. Adding two more factors gave many more.
scenes.visual: Day 1 and day 8 side by side, the greater epithelial ridge labelled in both. At day 8, ATOH1 alone gives few new cells; ATOH1 with GFI1 and POU4F3 gives many.
scenes.narration: By day eight, the factor alone gave very few new hair cells. Adding two more factors gave many more.

scenes.tts: Hair-cell genes also became less accessible with age. That makes chromatin a candidate barrier.
scenes.visual: Selected hair-cell regulatory regions drawn more open at day one and less open at day eight, with some regions still open.
scenes.narration: Hair-cell genes also became less accessible with age. That makes chromatin a candidate barrier.

scenes.tts: In mature mice, some reprogrammed cells grew rudimentary bundles. Nerve fibres were reported to contact them.
scenes.visual: A mature organ of Corti with one reprogrammed cell carrying a short, sparse bundle.
scenes.narration: In mature mice, some reprogrammed cells grew rudimentary bundles. Nerve fibres were reported to contact them.

scenes.tts: Whether those contacts are working synapses is the unsettled step.
scenes.visual: The new cell's contact with a nerve fibre drawn as a dashed line and a question mark.
scenes.narration: Whether those contacts are working synapses is the unsettled step.

scenes.tts: Replacing a link in a surviving cell is being done in children. Rebuilding the cell is not.
scenes.visual: Final card: one chain with a restored middle link, beside one chain with a missing first link and a question mark.
scenes.narration: Replacing a link in a surviving cell is being done in children. Rebuilding the cell is not.

scenes.visual: End card: Reading the Trial, and When the Cell Is Gone.
